randomSeedNote: Fixed RANDOM-SEED used for every generated (non hand written) golden record, mirroring the RANDSEED file that src/programs/test/TSTGEN00.cbl reads. Changing it changes the generated volume fixtures and therefore the goldens.
captureNote: captureRunDate is written by tools/golden/capture-cobol.sh when the COBOL goldens are captured. PORTADD and PORTUPDT stamp PORT-CREATE-DATE / PORT-LAST-MAINT from the system clock, so the normalizer rewrites any date field equal to the run date to the runDateToken on both the COBOL and the JS side.
